attempts.summary: Installed and configured a 3-node MariaDB Galera cluster (node1/node2/node3, MariaDB 10.11 + galera-4 on Ubuntu 24.04) after working around a blocked-port-80 apt mirror by switching sources to HTTPS. Created application data (appdb.orders), verified replication, then took the entire cluster down for a simulated maintenance window (stopped mariadb on all 3 nodes) and brought it back up by bootstrapping from the node with the highest Galera seqno (node1, safe_to_bootstrap=1) and rejoining node2/node3 — all committed writes (4 rows) were present afterward on all three members. Finally performed the mandatory one-at-a-time native reboot on each node, proving changed boot_id and full Galera cluster recovery (Primary/Synced, size=3, data intact) after each restart, preserving quorum throughout (only one node down at a time).
